items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: all I know of him playing bass drum rather than snare on him

ctx.x: Same thing. What about Henry Martin? Do you remember? Oh yeah, I remember him. He was a fine bass drum player. Was he mostly in parades or dance bands? Where did you hear him?
I never know of him playing in the orchestra in a band, I mean all I know of him playing bass drum rather than snare on him.
Yeah. Which band did he work with when you heard him, do you remember?
